summary: Ads-Tec Energy plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy materials for its 2026 Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 21, 2026. Proposals include receiving statutory financial statements, acknowledging auditor re-appointment, authorizing director remuneration, re-electing two Class II directors, and granting board authority to issue shares under Irish law. All proposals are recommended by the board for approval. This is a routine AGM notice and proxy solicitation, not a special situation. No unusual events, strategic actions, or activist campaigns are present; the filing merely complies with regulatory meeting requirements.
